description: Model contract for the LMDS platform. See CONTEXT.md for the domain language and docs/adr/0001 for the architectural decision.

$schema.description: URI of the JSON Schema used to validate this model descriptor

name.description: Unique name identifying the model. Used as the model key in API calls.

version.description: Semantic version string (e.g. 1.0.0). Auto-generated if not provided.

assets.description: Runtime files required by the model at execution time, such as pre-trained weights or lookup tables. Keys are target paths relative to the container WORKDIR; values are file-typed field declarations. Assets are immutable per ToolVersion.

parameters.description: Model-level configuration shared across all Modes — hyperparameters set once.

execution.description: Execution configuration: a map of named Modes the caller can select at run time.

modes.description: Free-form map of Modes keyed by Mode name. `instance` and `dataset` are conventional names, not a closed set. A model may declare one or many Modes.

mode.description: A named, self-contained I/O contract. Declares inputs, outputs, and the response model.

response.description: Delivery model for the Output JSON. `immediate`: the caller receives it in the response body (synchronous). `deferred`: the caller gets a job handle and polls for it later. Orthogonal to input/output shape. Defaults to `immediate`.

inputs.description: Named input Fields. Keys are input names, values are Field declarations. Optional — a Mode may take no inputs (parameter-only computation).

outputs.description: Named output Fields — value fields (handler returns them) and/or asset fields (handler writes the file, runner uploads it). Required: every Mode produces an Output JSON.

field.description: A named input or output Field. Either a value (inline literal: string, number, integer, boolean, array, object) or a file (storage-managed reference). `file` is a first-class type used identically for inputs and outputs; the runner reads direction from context (input -> download, output -> upload).

type.description: Data type. `file` is a storage-managed reference, not a literal in the JSON.

required.description: Whether this input must be provided. Meaningful for inputs; ignored for outputs. Default false.

default.description: Default value used when the Field is not specified

enum.description: Enumerated list of allowed values. The Field must match one of these.

format.description: Semantic format hint for string values. Not used for file Fields — file Fields use mime_type.

mime_type.description: MIME type. Required when type is `file`. Allows a single trailing `*` (e.g. `image/*`, `text/*`); `*/*` and partial wildcards (e.g. `image/pn*`) are not valid.

prefixItems.description: For tuple-like arrays: a schema for each position

minItems.description: Minimum number of items in the array

maxItems.description: Maximum number of items in the array
